AI IMAGE GENERATION

A little visual magic, included.

Every package includes up to 10 AI-generated images and up to 3 image revisions in total across the entire package. For example, generating 10 images does not include revising all 10. Each revision applies to one image and uses one of the 3 available revisions. I do not offer photo editing, but some image adjustments can be explored using AI, depending on the request.

What counts as CMS?

Here, a CMS means one content collection and its template, such as a blog, projects or team members. Individual entries are not static pages. Content entry, migration volume and any platform limits are confirmed in your quote.

What should you bring?

Your branding direction, copy and assets. Branding is not included. Hosting, platform subscriptions, paid tools and any additional language version are scoped separately in the final proposal.

CUSTOM SCOPE

More pages? A different mix?

If you need more than 25 static pages, more than 8 CMS collections, or a different combination of pages and functionality, write to me for a custom quote. Projects with 2 to 7 static pages can also be quoted individually.

Request a custom quote ↗
